nodes.title: View Pool Output
widgets_values:
## Output folders

Each run is saved under a new timestamped folder:

`ComfyUI/output/ViewPool/YYYY-MM-DD_HH-MM-SS/`

- `Run01` — absolute angles
- `Run02` — second absolute pass
- `Run03` — absolute pass with stronger 315° recovery wording

Select the source image, then click **Run**.
The "Edit Model Reference Method" nodes above are not needed if you use Comfy files, but may be needed if you use repackaged ones from other people.
